leads.title: Psalm 89, Ethan's hymn of the divine council, Rahab crushed, and the broken Davidic covenant ↔ Misers, those who called God poor, and the fire-consumed offering
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 shared wording.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/01-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: What man can live and not see death, or deliver his soul from the hand of Sheol? (weight 7.3); Every soul shall taste death (weight 6.6). Pair score 14.0.

Only in Psalm 89, Ethan's hymn of the divine council, Rahab crushed, and the broken Davidic covenant: The king calls God 'my father' and God makes him firstborn, highest of the kings of earth; God sets the king's hand on the Sea and his right hand on the Rivers; The dynasty will be established like the moon, a faithful witness in the sky; If the king's sons sin they will be punished with the rod, but God's love will not be withdrawn; God created Zaphon (north) and Yamin (south); Tabor and Hermon sing his name; God stills the roaring of the seas and the tumult of the peoples; Righteousness and justice are the foundation of God's throne; love and truth go before him; The king (or his name, dynasty, throne) will endure as long as the sun and moon; If there were other gods they would seek a way to the Lord of the Throne; God crushed Rahab like a corpse and scattered his enemies; Lament that God has spurned his anointed, defiled his crown and cast his throne to the ground; God gives strength to his king and exalts the horn of his anointed (messiah); and 14 more.

Only in Misers, those who called God poor, and the fire-consumed offering: God took the covenant of those given the Book to make it clear to people and not conceal it; Those who said 'God is poor and we are rich' are recorded and will taste the burning; Misers will have what they hoarded hung round their necks as a collar on the Day of Resurrection; Some demand that a messenger bring an offering consumed by fire as his credential; God grants the unbelievers respite only that they may increase in sin; Whether God is in need and humans rich [contrast between the texts]; An offering consumed by fire as proof of the true God or messenger [response between the texts]; Fire from heaven falls and consumes the offering, wood, stones, dust and water; God will not leave believers as they are until he separates the bad from the good; Wrongdoers take the deity's delay for indifference; the delay is not a release; A writer reproaches his addressee: the oath I made you swear before the gods you have thrown behind you; Fire comes out from before God and consumes the offering on the altar; and 4 more.

Shared motifs, rarest first: Mary asks how she will have a child when no man has touched her (weight 6.7); Jesus will speak to people in the cradle and in maturity (weight 6.7); The newborn speaks (weight 5.8); God creates by saying to a thing 'Be' and it is (kun fa-yakun) (weight 5.6). Pair score 24.7.

Only in The annunciation and the mission of Jesus: Deity breathes the breath of life into the first human's nostrils; Child makes birds from clay that come alive; Jesus asks 'Who are my helpers to God?' and the disciples (hawariyyun) answer 'We are God's helpers'; They plotted, and God plotted; God is the best of plotters; First human shaped from dust, clay or soil; Jesus heals the born-blind and the leper and raises the dead by God's leave; The likeness of Jesus with God is as Adam, created from dust by 'Be'; Jesus comes confirming the Torah and making lawful some of what was forbidden; God says to Jesus 'I will take you (mutawaffika) and raise you to myself and purify you'; Jesus tells people what they eat and store in their houses; Jesus announced as a word (kalima) from God, named the Messiah, Jesus son of Mary; Challenge to mutual imprecation (mubahala): gather sons, women and selves and invoke God's curse on the liars; Prophet is taken up alive to heaven in a whirlwind; God sent down the Torah (al-Tawrat) and the Gospel (al-Injil) before as guidance.

Only in Mary, the spirit in human form, the birth under the palm, the speaking infant (Surah 19:16-40): A divine messenger announces a son to a virgin untouched by any man; Mother gives birth alone in a remote place; The Day of Regret (yawm al-hasra) when the matter is decided; God's spirit appears to a woman in the form of a well-proportioned man; The prophet child is dutiful to his parent(s), not an arrogant tyrant; God answers doubt: 'It is easy for me; I created you before when you were nothing'; God gives life and death and is the inheritor of the earth and all on it; Denial that God has taken a son (walad); God does not beget and was not begotten; Jesus says 'worship God, my Lord and your Lord'; The infant Jesus declares himself God's servant, given the Book and made a prophet; 'That is Jesus son of Mary, the word of truth about which they dispute'; Labor pains drive the mother to the trunk of a palm tree; Mary is addressed as 'sister of Aaron'; Mary withdraws from her family to an eastern place behind a screen; A spring or stream appears for the mother; The mother returns with the child and her people accuse her of an enormity; In labor the mother wishes she had died before this and been utterly forgotten; A palm tree provides food to the mother; 'Peace on him the day he was born, the day he dies and the day he is raised alive'; The factions differ among themselves about Jesus; God breathed of his spirit into the woman who guarded her chastity; A voice from beneath her consoles the mother: 'do not grieve'; Mother keeps a vow of silence; Refrain 'And mention in the Book ...' introducing a series of prophet portraits; The woman seeks refuge in God from the mysterious visitor.
